title: Silent Witch Author Matsuri Isora Announces New Fantasy Novel
content: Matsuri Isora announced on Thursday that a new novel titled Bōkyaku no Curse Knight (Curse Knight of Oblivion) will ship on November 13 with illustrations by Shirotaka ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ).
author: ANN

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime Announces Ending Song Artists
content: The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series announced the anime's ending theme song on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: New Ahare! Meisaku-kun Anime Gets More Episodes Next January
content: The staff for the new Ahare! Meisaku-kun television anime announced on Tuesday that the anime will receive more episodes in January 2027. The anime will re-air previous episodes until then.
author: ANN

title: Netflix's Live-Action Quiztopia Series Unveils More Cast, December 17 Debut
content: Netflix revealed a teaser trailer, more cast members. and the December 17 global premiere for Quiztopia , its live-action series of Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinichi Katō 's Kokumin Quiz ( National Quiz ) manga, on Monday.
author: ANN

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Drops Special Trailer Ahead of Steel Ball Run Return
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and it looks more exciting than ever. It’s the final quarter of the year, which means all major platforms will be releasing new shows for the season. As one of the largest streaming giants across the world, Netflix isn’t going to be left behind either.
author: ComicBook

title: Akira Failing in Love Manga Tops 1 Million in Circulation Globally
content: This year's 42nd and 43rd combined issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced on September 16 that Shinta Harekawa 's Akira Failing in Love ( Momose Akira no Hatsukoi Hatan-chū ) manga has over 1 million copies in circulation worldwide.
author: ANN

title: Writer Tadashi Agi, Artist Jun Nakanishi's Foodies Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's Comic Days website posted the final chapter of Tadashi Agi and Jun Nakanishi 's Foodies manga on September 16. The manga's final chapter will become free to read on September 30. The manga launched on Comic Days in August 2025.
author: ANN

title: 3 Biggest Questions Crunchyroll’s Hottest New 2026 Anime Fails To Answer
content: The Summer 2026 season is also coming to an end, which means three-quarters of the year has already passed, and the majority of the anime that were set to debut on Crunchyroll have already premiered. This year has also been a very productive one for the anime industry, providing a variety of anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Shūichi Shigeno's Subaru and Subaru Manga Goes on Break Until October 26
content: This year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Friday that Shūichi Shigeno 's Subaru and Subaru ( Subaru to Subaru ) manga will take a break and will return in the magazine's 48th issue on October 26.
author: ANN

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Adds Aika Nakamura as New Social Link Character
content: The " Persona 4 Revival Broadcast" livestream revealed on Sunday that Atlus ' Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, will add a new social link character named Aika Nakamura.
author: ANN
